sloka: प्रजापति सुतः तु आसीत् कुशो नाम महीपतिः ।कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान् कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः ॥१-५१-१८॥
transliteration: prajāpati sutaḥ tu āsīt kuśo nāma mahīpatiḥ ।kuśasya putro balavān kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ ॥1-51-18॥

translations.english: There was a king named Kusa who was the son of Brahma. His son was Kusanabha who was supremely righteous and strong.
